theme.en: AI Supply Plans Advance Under Renewed Policy Scrutiny
theme.zh: AI供应布局推进，政策审视再度升温

dek.en: TSMC files an application for a proposed $22.6 billion Texas plant, while Micron accelerates HBM expansion in Singapore and Taiwan. Nvidia's leadership reversal and reported US plans to blacklist Megaspeed keep governance and export access in focus.
dek.zh: 台积电为拟建的226亿美元得州芯片厂提交申请，美光则加快在新加坡与台湾扩张HBM业务。英伟达领导层决定的逆转，以及美国据报拟将Megaspeed列入黑名单，使公司治理与出口准入继续成为焦点。

title.en: AI & Accelerators
title.zh: AI与加速器

title.en: Nvidia Board Reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO
title.zh: 英伟达董事会恢复黄仁勋CEO职务

summary.en: Nvidia's board has reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO following his resignation, EE Times reports, describing a reversal after about a week. The decision restores the founder to leadership of a central supplier in the AI hardware market. The supplied report excerpt does not identify changes to the company's product roadmap or customer commitments.
summary.zh: 据EE Times报道，英伟达董事会在黄仁勋辞职约一周后，恢复其CEO职务。这项决定使创始人重新掌舵这家AI硬件市场的核心供应商。所提供的报道摘录未提及公司产品路线图或客户交付承诺发生变化。

title.en: Amazon Acquires Technology and Talent Targeting AI Accelerator Utilization
title.zh: 亚马逊收购旨在提高AI加速器利用率的技术与人才

summary.en: Amazon is acquiring AI accelerator technology and the people behind it rather than the entire startup, The Register reports. The reported focus is keeping chips busy, putting utilization alongside chip performance as a route to better infrastructure economics. The supplied excerpt does not name the startup, disclose terms or quantify the expected gains.
summary.zh: 据The Register报道，亚马逊正在收购一项AI加速器技术及其背后的团队，交易范围并不包括整家初创公司。报道将重点放在提高芯片利用率上，说明改善基础设施经济性还取决于让已有算力充分工作。所提供的摘录未说明初创公司名称、交易条款或预期收益幅度。

title.en: Foundry & Manufacturing
title.zh: 晶圆代工与制造

title.en: TSMC Files Application for Proposed $22.6 Billion Texas Chip Plant
title.zh: 台积电为拟建的226亿美元得州芯片厂提交申请

summary.en: TSMC has filed an application for a proposed $22.6 billion chip plant in Brazos County, Texas, according to KCEN. The proposal would add another potential location to the company's US manufacturing footprint. An application is an early project milestone; the supplied excerpt does not establish a final investment decision, process node, production capacity or opening date.
summary.zh: 据KCEN报道，台积电已为拟在美国得克萨斯州Brazos县建设的226亿美元芯片厂提交申请。该提案为公司的美国制造布局增加了一个潜在地点。提交申请属于项目前期节点；所提供的摘录尚不能确认最终投资决定、制程、产能或投产日期。

title.en: ASU-Led SWAP Hub Receives $11.4 Million for Microelectronics Work
title.zh: 亚利桑那州立大学牵头的SWAP Hub获1140万美元微电子资金

summary.en: The ASU-led SWAP Hub has received $11.4 million for the next phase of its national security microelectronics work, ASU News reports. The award supports a further phase of the research effort, adding funding to the US microelectronics development pipeline. The supplied excerpt does not specify the funded projects or their transition to manufacturing.
summary.zh: 据ASU News报道，由亚利桑那州立大学牵头的SWAP Hub获得1140万美元，用于下一阶段的国家安全微电子工作。这笔资金支持该研究计划继续推进，为美国微电子研发链条补充投入。所提供的摘录未说明具体资助项目及其转入制造的安排。

title.en: Memory
title.zh: 存储

title.en: Micron Accelerates HBM Expansion in Singapore and Taiwan
title.zh: 美光加快在新加坡与台湾扩张HBM业务

summary.en: Micron is accelerating HBM expansion in Singapore and Taiwan, Chosunbiz reports. The move places both locations in the company's effort to expand a memory technology central to AI accelerators. The supplied excerpt gives no investment amount, incremental output or qualification timetable, so the pace of additional supply remains unquantified.
summary.zh: 据Chosunbiz报道，美光正加快在新加坡与台湾扩张HBM业务。这使两地共同参与公司对AI加速器关键存储技术的扩张布局。所提供的摘录未给出投资额、新增产出或认证时间表，因此尚无法量化新增供应的释放节奏。

title.en: Penguin Demonstrates Optical Memory Box with Up to 576 GB of HBM3E
title.zh: Penguin展示光互连存储盒，最高配备576 GB HBM3E

summary.en: Penguin Solutions demonstrated an external memory box at SC26 with up to 576 GB of HBM3E and 16 TB of DDR5, connected to hosts through optical links, Tom's Hardware reports. The device explores expanding AI accelerator memory capacity beyond local memory, with customer samples expected in 2027. Compatibility is a material constraint: the report says it does not appear to support existing servers and accelerators.
summary.zh: 据Tom's Hardware报道，Penguin Solutions在SC26展示了一款通过光链路连接主机的外置存储盒，最高配备576 GB HBM3E和16 TB DDR5。该设备探索将AI加速器的存储容量扩展到本地存储之外，预计于2027年提供客户样品。兼容性是重要限制：报道指出，它似乎不支持现有服务器与加速器。

title.en: Samsung Promotes 131 Executives with a Focus on Technical Talent
title.zh: 三星晋升131名高管，强调技术人才

summary.en: Samsung Electronics has promoted 131 executives while prioritizing technology talent, Chosunbiz reports. The appointments are a personnel signal to watch as the company's semiconductor businesses execute their roadmaps. The headline does not establish changes to HBM output, customer qualification or capital spending.
summary.zh: 据Chosunbiz报道，三星电子晋升131名高管，并将技术人才置于优先位置。在其半导体业务推进路线图之际，这轮任命提供了值得跟踪的人事信号。该标题本身并不能证明HBM产出、客户认证或资本开支发生变化。

title.en: Equipment & Manufacturing Skills
title.zh: 设备与制造技能

title.en: Festo and NOCTI Announce Semiconductor Cleanroom Training Certification
title.zh: Festo与NOCTI推出半导体洁净室培训认证

summary.en: Festo and NOCTI have announced a new cleanroom certification for semiconductor manufacturing training, according to TMCnet. The initiative addresses workforce preparation, a practical requirement for operating fabs and their equipment. The supplied announcement excerpt does not describe assessment standards, participating employers or training scale.
summary.zh: 据TMCnet报道，Festo与NOCTI宣布推出面向半导体制造培训的新洁净室认证。该计划针对人才培养，而具备相应技能的人员是晶圆厂及其设备运行的实际前提。所提供的公告摘录未说明考核标准、参与雇主或培训规模。

title.en: Policy & Export Controls
title.zh: 政策与出口管制

title.en: US Reportedly Plans to Blacklist Megaspeed over Chip Export Concerns
title.zh: 美国据报拟因芯片出口疑虑将Megaspeed列入黑名单

summary.en: The US plans to blacklist Megaspeed over chip export concerns, Investing.com reports, citing Semafor. The report brings another intermediary into scrutiny of access to advanced chips. The selected report describes a planned action; its supplied excerpt does not establish an effective date or the scope of any final restrictions.
summary.zh: Investing.com援引Semafor报道称，美国计划因芯片出口疑虑将Megaspeed列入黑名单。这使又一家中间商进入围绕先进芯片获取渠道的审查视野。所选报道描述的是拟议行动，其摘录尚不能确定生效日期或最终限制范围。

title.en: EU Export-Control List Update Covers Semiconductors and Industrial Thresholds
title.zh: 欧盟出口管制清单更新涉及半导体及工业门槛

summary.en: The National Law Review reports an EU export-control list update involving new semiconductor controls and revised industrial thresholds. The coverage flags classification and licensing questions for suppliers handling potentially covered products. The supplied excerpt does not identify technical thresholds, exemptions or implementation dates, so it cannot support a product-specific compliance conclusion.
summary.zh: The National Law Review报道，欧盟出口管制清单更新涉及新增半导体管制及调整工业门槛。这篇报道提示，经营潜在受控产品的供应商需要关注分类与许可问题。所提供的摘录未列出技术门槛、豁免或实施日期，因此无法据此对具体产品作出合规判断。

theme.en: Inference Efficiency Depends on Memory and Execution
theme.zh: 推理效率取决于存储组织与执行方式

dek.en: Eight preprints examine heterogeneous memory, vector quantization, MoE execution, compact model states and RFIC layout analysis. The reading queue emphasizes mechanisms that change hardware workload, with reported results kept within their stated evaluation scope.
dek.zh: 本期8篇预印本涵盖异构存储、向量量化、MoE执行、紧凑模型状态及RFIC版图分析。选文聚焦能够改变硬件负载的机制，量化结果均保留其原有评测范围。

title.en: AI Accelerators & Compute-in-Memory
title.zh: AI加速器与存算一体

title.en: FOREST Coordinates HBF, RRAM and HBM for Speculative LLM Inference
title.zh: FOREST协同HBF、RRAM与HBM支持大模型推测式推理

papers.authors: Hao Ding, Zheng Shi, Dongxue Zhao, et al.

summary.en: FOREST proposes a heterogeneous memory-centric architecture that coordinates HBF, 3D-stacked RRAM and HBM memory-compute trees for speculative decoding. Its design separates the demands of latency-sensitive drafting, weight-intensive target verification and growing KV-cache attention, including wide low-frequency RRAM reads and overlapped SRAM-DCIM weight refills. This targets the resource mismatch of serving all stages through shared HBM, but the supplied abstract ends before evaluation results and does not establish measured-silicon performance.
summary.zh: FOREST提出以存储为中心的异构架构，协同HBF、3D堆叠RRAM与HBM存储计算树来执行推测解码。该设计区分低延迟草稿生成、密集读取权重的目标模型验证，以及KV-cache不断增长的注意力计算，并采用超宽低频RRAM读取和可重叠的SRAM-DCIM权重补充。这一方案针对所有阶段共用HBM带来的资源错配，但所提供的摘要在评测结果之前已截断，尚不能据此确认实测芯片性能。

title.en: VQACC Reuses Operand Buffers for Ultra-Low-Bit LLM Inference
title.zh: VQACC复用操作数缓冲器支持超低位宽大模型推理

papers.authors: Hao Wang, Yang Shi, Jiageng Shi, et al.

summary.en: VQACC changes operand-buffer access logic and data mapping so systolic-array LLM accelerators can reuse existing storage and ports for vector-quantization codebook lookups. By integrating dequantization into operand addressing, it targets the lookup overhead that can erode the benefit of ultra-low-bit weights. The authors report a 2.63-fold speedup over EVA; the supplied abstract truncates the hardware-overhead description and provides no measured-silicon evidence.
summary.zh: VQACC通过调整操作数缓冲器的访问逻辑与数据映射，让采用脉动阵列的大模型加速器复用现有存储和端口执行向量量化码本查找。它将反量化融入操作数寻址流程，针对查表开销侵蚀超低位宽权重收益的问题。作者报告，相比EVA基线实现2.63倍加速；所提供的摘要截断了硬件开销说明，也未提供实测芯片证据。

title.en: Inference Systems, Memory & Compression
title.zh: 推理系统、存储与压缩

title.en: Weave Adapts MoE Megakernel Warp Scheduling to Routing Loads
title.zh: Weave按路由负载动态调整MoE巨型内核的warp调度

papers.authors: Ziyu Huang, Yangjie Zhou, Chenhao Zhu, et al.

summary.en: Weave schedules communication and computation within a persistent MoE megakernel at both SM and warp granularity, adapting resource allocation to routing-dependent loads. Its temporal schedule also changes warp roles during execution to reduce idle periods at layer boundaries and around data dependencies. The mechanism addresses utilization lost when whole SMs are reserved for communication, but the supplied abstract does not include benchmark speedups.
summary.zh: Weave在常驻MoE巨型内核中，以SM和warp两种粒度调度通信与计算，使资源分配适应由路由结果决定的负载。其时间调度还会在执行过程中切换warp角色，以减少层起止阶段及数据依赖附近的空闲。该机制针对将整个SM保留给通信所造成的利用率损失，但所提供的摘要未包含基准测试加速比。

title.en: IsoMoE Preserves Outputs Across CPU-GPU Expert Placement
title.zh: IsoMoE保持不同CPU与GPU专家放置下的输出一致性

papers.authors: Hang Gu, Teng Wang, Zhendong Zheng, et al.

summary.en: IsoMoE proposes hybrid CPU-GPU MoE inference whose outputs remain unchanged when experts move between devices, using a GPU kernel that reproduces CPU expert arithmetic bit for bit. It combines a layout for AVX-512 computation on lossless 12-bit experts with a dual micro-batch pipeline that overlaps CPU and GPU work. The approach targets both reproducibility and CPU memory traffic; the supplied abstract cuts off during the three-model evaluation and does not support a numerical throughput claim.
summary.zh: IsoMoE提出CPU与GPU混合MoE推理系统，通过让GPU内核逐位复现CPU专家运算，使专家在设备间移动时输出保持一致。它将面向AVX-512的无损12位专家计算布局，与重叠执行CPU和GPU任务的双微批流水线结合。该方法同时针对结果可复现性与CPU内存流量；所提供的摘要在三个模型的评测部分被截断，尚不能支持具体吞吐提升数字。

title.en: MemOnce Reconstructs KV Caches from Compact Memory States
title.zh: MemOnce从紧凑记忆状态重建KV-cache

papers.authors: Chang Nie, Chaoyou Fu, Songlin Liu, et al.

summary.en: MemOnce caches a small subset of final-layer hidden states and dynamically decodes them into attention-layer KV caches, rather than retaining every layer's token-level cache. Sparse memory retrieval computes indices once across layers, targeting the GPU memory growth of long-running interactions without relying solely on a fixed-size history state. The authors claim linear-time complexity, but the supplied abstract stops before experimental details, leaving retention quality and serving costs unquantified.
summary.zh: MemOnce缓存少量末层隐藏状态，再动态将其解码为各注意力层的KV-cache，从而避免保留每层逐词元的完整缓存。其稀疏记忆检索在各层之间只计算一次索引，旨在缓解长时交互中的GPU内存增长，同时避免完全依赖固定大小的历史状态。作者声称可实现线性时间复杂度，但所提供的摘要在实验细节之前已结束，尚无法量化细节保留能力与服务成本。

title.en: DPMA Learns Joint Pruning and Merging Under an MoE Expert Budget
title.zh: DPMA在MoE专家预算下联合学习剪枝与合并

papers.authors: Jon Irureta, Jon Imaz, Philipp Wiesner, et al.

summary.en: DPMA jointly learns expert pruning, parameter merging and routing-weight reassignment under a global expert budget while keeping model weights frozen. Across four MoE models, eight multiple-choice benchmarks and five compression ratios, it achieves the best benchmark-and-ratio averaged accuracy on every model among the evaluated methods. At 75% expert reduction it beats the strongest baseline on every model by up to 6.7 percentage points, although this accuracy result does not by itself establish deployment speed or energy savings.
summary.zh: DPMA在全局专家预算约束下，联合学习专家剪枝、参数合并与路由权重重分配，并保持模型权重冻结。在四个MoE模型、八项选择题基准与五种压缩比例的评测中，它在每个模型上跨基准和压缩比例的平均准确率均为所比较方法中最高。专家数量减少75%时，它在每个模型上都超过最强基线，最大优势为6.7个百分点，但准确率结果本身尚不能证明实际部署中的速度或能耗收益。

title.en: Model Carving Learns Transformer Topology During Training
title.zh: Model Carving在训练过程中学习Transformer拓扑

summary.en: Model Carving applies learnable scalar gates to Transformer sublayers so training jointly optimizes weights and removes components, producing a smaller heterogeneous topology. Tests cover standard Transformers from 140M to 2.7B parameters and looped Transformers from 140M to 1.3B. The authors report that carved models trained at a given compute budget reach lower validation loss than dense models using up to 1.7 times as much compute; the excerpt does not quantify inference latency on hardware.
summary.zh: Model Carving为Transformer子层加入可学习的标量门控，使训练在优化权重的同时移除组件，形成更小的异构拓扑。实验覆盖1.4亿至27亿参数的标准Transformer，以及1.4亿至13亿参数的循环Transformer。作者报告，在给定训练算力预算下，裁刻模型的验证损失低于使用至多1.7倍算力的稠密模型；摘录未量化其在硬件上的推理延迟。

title.en: RFIC Design & Engineering Automation
title.zh: RFIC设计与工程自动化

title.en: Can Language Models Read Pixelated RFIC Passive Layouts?
title.zh: 语言模型能否读懂像素化RFIC无源器件版图？

summary.en: This study asks a language model with all tools disabled to predict 20–100 GHz input impedance and loss from pixelated passive layouts on 18-by-18 and 27-by-27 grids. Across eight genetic-algorithm-synthesized layouts and five random fills, predicted Smith-chart trajectories broadly follow full-wave simulations, but their features appear about 16% lower in frequency. The result suggests a possible aid for interpreting inverse-designed layouts, while the systematic bias and small test set limit its use as a substitute for electromagnetic verification.
summary.zh: 研究要求一个关闭全部工具的语言模型，根据18×18和27×27网格上的像素化无源器件版图，预测20至100 GHz范围内的输入阻抗与损耗。在八个由遗传算法合成的版图及五个随机填充结构上，预测的Smith圆图轨迹总体跟随全波仿真结果，但特征频率系统性地偏低约16%。结果表明，该方法或可辅助理解逆向设计版图，但系统偏差与较小测试集限制了其替代电磁验证的能力。
